claims.claim: Carpenter's FY2026 aerospace and defense net sales excluding surcharge grew 15% year over year, reinforcing exposure to high-performance alloy demand in critical applications.

risks.risk: Aerospace/defense concentration increases sensitivity to program cycles and specialty-alloy end demand.

unknowns.unknown: Customer concentration and capacity utilization by critical alloy family are not quantified in the release.

claims.claim: FY2026 was Carpenter's most profitable year: adjusted operating income reached $702.0 million, up 34%, with $362.3 million adjusted free cash flow; Q4 SAO adjusted operating margin reached 37.8%.

risks.risk: Higher capex and working-capital needs reduced Q4 adjusted free cash flow versus the prior-year quarter despite higher earnings.

unknowns.unknown: FY2027 guidance conversion into realized volume, mix and margin remains future execution.
